facts.fact: Open the UP e-District portal (edistrict.up.gov.in/edistrictup/), click Citizen login (e-Sathi) and register with your personal and contact details
facts.quote: The applicant shall open the Online e-District Portal using the address https://edistrict.up.gov.in/edistrictup/ and click on Citizen login (e-Sathi). b) Register in online portal using their personal details and contact details.

facts.fact: After logging in, select the 'Caste Certificate' service under the Revenue Department
facts.quote: Applicant shall select “Caste Certificate” service under Revenue Department.

facts.fact: Pay the user charge of Rs 15 through the online payment gateway
facts.quote: Applicant shall pay the user charges i.e., Rs 15/- through online payment gateway.

facts.fact: Fill in the details, attach the documents in the Caste Certificate application form and submit it
facts.quote: Applicant shall fill details, attach documents in application form for “Caste Certificate” & submit it.

behaviour: Gives the steps from edistrict.up.gov.in with citation (crawled), or, if Central only, names the responsible State department (Revenue) and links its portal (as listed in IGOD); a bare 'not covered' fails; no invented State steps; replies in Hinglish.
fail_if: It says only 'not covered' without naming the UP department or portal, or invents UP steps, documents or fees not on official pages.
summary: UP e-District procedure sheet: e-Sathi login/registration, Caste Certificate under Revenue Department, Rs 15 user charge online, fill, attach documents and submit.
